title: Spring Tech Table
description: Kickoff of Tech Tables, conducting Tech Committee reflecting on the year so far, what is coming up in 2026, and open discussion on planning ahead. Wrap-up includes a one-hour happy hour to celebrate the release of the Planning with a Black Mirror card game. The American Planning Association's (APA) Technology Division created a scenario-based card game, to help planners collaboratively explore the impacts of emerging technologies and unpredictable events on communities. Please come expecting to learn and play with your fellow planners!
location: VHB - One Penn Plaza, New York

title: Summer Tech Table: AI in Practice
description: A deep dive into how AI tools are being used in real planning workflows — from automated permit review to scenario modeling. Members will share live demos and lessons learned from their own projects. Open discussion on where the technology is heading and what planners need to watch out for.

title: Fall Tech Table: Open Data & Civic Tech
description: Exploring NYC's open data landscape and how civic technologists are building tools that planners can use today. Featuring demos from NYC OpenData team members and community-built tools like ZAP trackers and 311 analyzers. Come ready to discuss what data you wish existed and what you'd build with it.

title: Winter Tech Table: Year in Review
description: Close out the year with the Tech Committee community. We'll review what we accomplished in 2026, preview the 2027 calendar, and swap predictions on what tech will shake up planning next year. Light refreshments provided.
